'''Tatrang I''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] rock [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Tatrang system]],<ref name="PotG2" /> a part of the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet occupied the closest [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] to its [[Star/Legends|star]], the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] [[Tatrang]]. Tatrang I was lifeless and was considered commercially worthless.<ref name="PotG2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tatrang I was first mentioned in the [[1992]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]'', which was written by [[John Terra]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="PotG2" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tatrang [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet, in grid square U-14.<ref name="TEA" />
